journal_lines: Smelled it first — rot and old cloth. Put it down before it turned around.
Groaning thing in the corridor. Cleared it.
§cGrabbed my leg. §oStrong for something that slow.§o Pulled free. Dealt with it.
Two of them at the cave mouth. Gone before they reached me.
Heard it shuffling in the dark a long time before it found me.
§oSmell hits you well before the sound does.§o Backed up, circled, came in from behind.
Slow thing. Patient thing. Neither saved it.
Found me by scent — I know how they work. Came at it from upwind.
§lZombie§l in the trench, arms out, walking nowhere in particular. Took care of it.
§cBite on the shoulder. §oNot deep.§o Shook it off and finished it.
